deoksugung-royal-guard-changing-ceremony.note: Ceremony at 11:00 and 14:00, about 25 minutes. No Monday ceremony; weather can cancel a session. Palace admission is separate.

seoul-international-garden-show-2026.note: An independent garden walk and a reserved hosted program are different visits. Check the particular program's hours; the source pages do not give one consistent closing time for everything.

national-geographic-ocean-seoul-2026.note: Last entry 18:00; closes 19:00. Closed Mondays and September 24–25. Paid tickets; English interpretation and overseas checkout are not confirmed.

gwangalli-m-drone-light-show-2026.note: Saturday shows only in the regular schedule. Weather and special notices can change or cancel them; check the operator before travelling.

dateTimes.2026-09-26: 20:00 only: one Chuseok drone-and-laser performance; no 22:00 show.

andong-maskdance-festival-2026.note: Pick a named performance and venue on the operator's daily program. Hahoe Village and the performance hall are separate destinations. A festival date does not confirm a specific performance or ticket.

jinju-namgang-yudeung-festival-2026.note: General lighting 18:00–24:00. Bridge operation ends at 23:00, ticketing at 22:50. A paid crossing is separate from general viewing; protect your return bank.

dateNotes.2026-10-03: Opening lighting ceremony at 19:30 at the Mangyeong-dong special stage; do not treat 18:00 as its start time.
